name: GTD for Beginners
instructions: Start GTD small: spend 10 minutes today doing a full "brain dump" of everything on your mind onto one list.
Go through the list and turn each vague item into a concrete next action ("plan trip" becomes "look up flight prices").
Review your full list once a week to keep it current and trustworthy -- an outdated list stops being useful fast.
Watch today's video for a simpler, beginner-friendly walkthrough of GTD.
